For 1039m837n to be divisible by 9, the sum of digits must be divisible 9.

1 + 0 + 3 + 9 + m + 8 + 3 + 7 + n = 31 + m + n

31 + m + n = 36 or 45

m + n = 5 or 14, but as n = 6 , m + n = 14

Clearly, m = 14 – 6 = 8

n2-m4= 62- 84  = 7

questions.q:
There are two numbers X and Y such that X is equal to the sum of all prime numbers between 118 and 140 and Y is equal to the sum of composite numbers from 61 to 97, then what is the difference between X and Y?

दो संखाएं X और Y इस प्रकार से हैं कि X, 118 और 140 के बीच सभी अभाज्य संख्याओं के योग के बराबर है और Y, 61 से 97 के बीच संयुक्त संख्याओं के योग के बराबर है, तो X और Y के बीच का अंतर कितना है?
questions.s:
All prime numbers between 118 and 140 = {127, 131, 137, 139}

Sum = 127 + 131 + 137 + 139 = 534

Sum of all natural-numbers from 61 to 97 = (97 - 61 + 1)/2 * (61 + 97) = 2923

And all prime numbers from 61 to 97 = {61, 67, 71, 73, 79, 83, 89, 97}

Sum = 61 + 67 + 71 + 73 + 79 + 83 + 89 + 97 = 620

So, sum of all composite numbers from 61 to 97 = 2923 - 620 = 2303

So, required difference = 2303 - 534 = 1769

questions.q:
Remainder obtained after dividing a number by 8 is 3 and when the same number is divided by 9, remainder becomes 6. If difference between quotients in both the cases is 2, then find the number.

किसी संख्या को 8 से भाग देने पर शेषफल 3 आता है तथा जब उसी संख्या को 9 से भाग दिया जाता है तो शेषफल 6 रह जाता है। यदि दोनों स्थितियों में भागफलों का अंतर 2 है, तो संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.s:
Let number = N

Let quotient when N is divided by 8 is 'x' and it is given that difference between quotient in both the cases is 2.

Quotient when a number is divided by smaller number is always more than when the same number is divided by greater number.

Hence, quotient when N is divided by 9 is 'x - 2'

We know that:

Dividend = Divisor * Quotient + Remainder

N = 8x + 3 ...... (1)

N = 9 (x - 2) + 6 ...... (2)

From (1) and (2):

8x + 3 = 9 (x - 2) + 6

8x + 3 = 9x - 18 + 6

x = 12 + 3

x = 15

Hence, number = N = 8x + 3

= 8 * 15 + 3

= 123

There are two numbers X and Y such that X is equal to the sum of all prime numbers between 118 and 140 and Y is equal to the sum of composite numbers from 61 to 97, then what is the difference between X and Y?

Sum = 127 + 131 + 137 + 139 = 534

Sum of all natural-numbers from 61 to 97 = (97 - 61 + 1)/2 * (61 + 97) = 2923

So, sum of all composite numbers from 61 to 97 = 2923 - 620 = 2303

So, required difference = 2303 - 534 = 1769

questions_hin.q_hi:
Remainder obtained after dividing a number by 8 is 3 and when the same number is divided by 9, remainder becomes 6. If difference between quotients in both the cases is 2, then find the number.

किसी संख्या को 8 से भाग देने पर शेषफल 3 आता है तथा जब उसी संख्या को 9 से भाग दिया जाता है तो शेषफल 6 रह जाता है। यदि दोनों स्थितियों में भागफलों का अंतर 2 है, तो संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let number = N

Let quotient when N is divided by 8 is 'x' and it is given that difference between quotient in both the cases is 2.

Quotient when a number is divided by smaller number is always more than when the same number is divided by greater number.

Hence, quotient when N is divided by 9 is 'x - 2'

We know that:

Dividend = Divisor * Quotient + Remainder

N = 8x + 3 ...... (1)

N = 9 (x - 2) + 6 ...... (2)

From (1) and (2):

8x + 3 = 9 (x - 2) + 6

8x + 3 = 9x - 18 + 6

x = 12 + 3

x = 15

Hence, number = N = 8x + 3

= 8 * 15 + 3

= 123
